descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S23 「现成 spec：正好两个带版本的 Bedrock 模型 ID 能调用，默认是带日期的 Haiku 4.5，IAM 一致」 Existing specs: exactly two versioned Bedrock model IDs are invocable, the default is dated Haiku 4.5, and IAM matches

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U7 The guardrail configuration (ADDRESS/PHONE = None) and the model ID are version-pinned in production and match what UAT ran on.（UAT OAT-05；UAT 3.1；TFA-94059 AC 6） — gate: blocked: TFA-94059 in progress

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given providers.spec.ts (no backend needed)

When Resolve the default model and a model just outside the allowed set (Sonnet or Opus IDs), and compare the IAM policy's model list with ALLOWED_MODELS

Then The default is us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0. Only that and mistral.mistral-large-3-675b-instruct resolve; the others throw 'is not allowed'. The IAM policy allows exactly the same set.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions in api/providers.spec.ts. This is the code half of step 7's 'model ID version-pinned'. Production is S19.

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 STATIC · 静态检查（构建产物 / 扫描）；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S23 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-05.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：STATIC · 静态检查（构建产物 / 扫描）；辅助：CONFIG · 配置核对 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。

This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
